_comment: Pinned fixture for AC-65.2 — PumpSwap AMM constant-product quote + fee math. All integer values in on-chain units (lamports / base token units). Expected results computed offline with integer arithmetic and pinned here.

global_config._note: lp_fee=0.25% (25 bps) + protocol_fee=0.05% (5 bps) + creator_fee=0.00% (0 bps) = total 0.30% (30 bps). These are the canonical PumpSwap GlobalConfig defaults read from pinned fixture values, NOT from a live RPC call.

pool_reserve_fixture._note: Representative graduated-token pool: 1 trillion base units (1M tokens at 6 decimals) and 85 billion lamports (85 SOL). Spot price = 85e9 / 1e12 = 0.085 lamports per base unit.

spot_price_fixture._note: quote_reserve / base_reserve = 85_000_000_000 / 1_000_000_000_000 = 0.085 (lamports per base unit, exact float)

zero_reserve_guard_cases._note: All of these must raise ZeroReserveError (H4). Never silently proceed to division.
